title: Ask runs inside Photonz, with no Ollama or any other program to open
goal: Ask works because Photonz is open, and that is all. The model runs inside the app, and its download is offered and shown in Settings > Ask. Nobody has to install, open or keep running Ollama or any other program, on this Mac or any other. Today Ask talks to Ollama, so it does nothing unless Ollama is installed and open.
notes: User, 2026-10-22: 'we should not have a dependency on opening ollama', then 'is there a way to not have the user micromanage apps running'. This makes it the user's task, and it beats the old line that kept today's Ollama setup working as the default. Focus success gap: agent-ask success item 2 says which models answer 'works out of the box'. Today Ask needs Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 (Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskLocalModel.swift:10) with qwen3:30b, 18.6 GB (AskPlanning.swift:503, AskModels). With no Ollama it says 'Ask needs Ollama. See Settings.' (AskLocalModel.swift:30-31) and Settings links Ollama's website. The 2026-10-19 Ask audit's last rough line: that path was never walked, since this Mac has Ollama. Apple's FoundationModels was rejected for a 4,096 token window against about 5,800 tokens of tools plus document (docs/design/ask.md, model table): a tool list cut per request (looking tools plus the four or five doing tools the request needs) may fit, measure it. An in-app runtime (for example MLX Swift with a downloaded model) avoids a second program. Not reproduced as a click on a fresh Mac by the manager (this Mac has Ollama); the code path above is what a Mac without it reaches. Do not uninstall or stop the person's Ollama; use a seam on the probe. Runs after the eval task if it is done, otherwise score by the three walks and the eval's rubric by hand.
acceptance: Reproduce first: with the local model runner Ask uses today made unreachable to the probe (stopped, or its port pointed elsewhere through a test seam), press Ask on a screenshot and record what the person sees. That is the before picture

With Ollama quit, or not installed, Ask answers and draws as well as it does today with Ollama open (scored with the eval and the held-out set, the numbers in the audit). Photonz never launches, calls or needs Ollama on any path at Next defaults, and a test proves no Ask code path touches 127.0.0.1:11434 by default

The model runs in Photonz's own process or in a helper that Photonz ships inside the app and starts and stops itself (for example MLX Swift). Name the runtime and the model in the audit, with the time to first answer and the memory it holds
Ollama may stay as an optional setting for people who want it, off by default. Taking it out entirely is also fine; log which was chosen and why

Nothing Ask uses needs managing by the person: the chat model and the picture model start when Ask first needs them, and are let go (memory freed) after a few idle minutes and when Photonz quits. Nothing is left running after quit (checked in the audit with the process list), and no message ever says to open, start or restart a program
After the change, from that state a person reaches a working answer in at most two clicks from Ask's own message, never leaving Photonz for the Terminal or another website
Anything downloaded says its size and where it goes before it starts, shows progress, can be stopped, and lives in Settings > Ask; while it gets ready Ask says so in one short plain sentence

Pick the in-app way, measure it and log why (do not stop to ask): a model run inside Photonz itself, the Mac's own on-device model with a smaller tool list chosen per request, or both. The pick must make the three try requests (screenshot measurements, the Case 1 title page before a clip, a pricing section on brand) come out at least as well as today's default model, scored with the eval from a-scored-test-set-for-what-ask-and-the-photonz-s, with the time to a result for each in the audit
After setup, with the app's network blocked (a block on the probe, never the person's Wi-Fi while the loop runs), the three try requests still run
Shipped behind next-ask at Next defaults; try path: Settings > Ask from nothing set up, then Ask on a screenshot. Copy is short and plain, no em dashes, no vendor names

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the before and after pictures and the timings. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

The picture model Ask paints its drawings with (Scripts/picture-model, Z-Image Turbo about 11 GB, on at Next defaults since 2026-10-22) is part of the same setup: installed from Settings > Ask with its size shown, started and stopped by Photonz when Ask needs it, never by a person running serve.sh, and with no Python or other install the person has to make. Without it Ask falls back to its old drawing route, which scored 35.9 against painting's held-out total

Chose llama.cpp's llama-server (b11826, MIT, prebuilt arm64, pinned by sha256 in Vendor/llama-server/VERSION) shipped in Contents/Helpers/AskModel and started by Photonz, over MLX Swift (a large new dependency whose Metal shaders SwiftPM does not build) and over Apple's on-device model (4,096 token window against Ask's ~10,400 token first prompt). Same Qwen3.6 27B weights as today's Ollama default, as GGUF from ggml-org at a pinned revision.

Chose to keep Ollama as an opt-in Settings toggle ('Use Ollama instead', off by default) over removing it: the bake-off and anyone with models there can still use them; nothing reaches 11434 otherwise (test: only AskRuntime names that port).

Measured: server loads Qwen3.6 27B in 8-13 s; holds 22.8 GB (RSS); reads prompts at ~217 tok/s (llama-bench pp4096: fa on/off and ubatch 512/2048 all 182-217), so Ask's ~10,400-token first prompt takes ~47 s cold. Later turns of a request take 1-5 s (prefix reuse). Send-to-done on the screenshot request from cold: 60 s (walk). Ollama's MLX engine read the first prompt much faster; that gap is the main thing left on the chat side.

Bug found and fixed while building: warming the server on the first keystroke let a request reach it before it finished loading; the request then stopped it ('Ask's model didn't start'). Requests now wait for the load. Caught by the first eval run (all 41 cases 0.1 s), whose history line was removed as not a measurement of the model.
owns these walks: ask-sets-itself-up-walk, ask-annotates-a-screenshot-walk

Climb set, 41 cases, cold each case, no picture model: built-in Qwen3.6 35B-A3B 55.3 (drawing 61.5, sheet 17.7, layout 19, redline 46.6, video 39.5; 22.7 s median; run 20261022-204744-ask) against Ollama qwen3.6:27b 53.1 (56.7, 21.2, 11.2, 47.4, 52.1; 23.7 s; run 20261022-212621-ask, a temporary ollama serve I started and stopped, the person's app untouched). Built-in 27B stopped after 10 cases (62 average, 88-146 s a case, one 300 s timeout): too slow at 217 tok/s prompt reading. Chose Qwen3.6 35B-A3B as the default over the 27B because it scores the same or better at a quarter of the time in this runtime.

Three named requests, built-in vs Ollama: screenshot measurements 46.6 vs 47.4 (10.3 s vs 50 s), Case 1 title page 84.4 vs 79.6 (10 s vs 5 s), pricing on brand 19 vs 11.2 (37.7 s vs 82.8 s). Memory held 21.7 GB (RSS). After quit: pgrep finds no llama-server (checked after every walk).
